pages.heading: Cachalot Whale
pages.body: Several ocean types, including deep oceans. Keep boats clear of charging whales. A whale stranded during a thunderstorm can reward a rescue with Ambergris if returned

pages.heading: Cachalot Whale (cont.)
pages.body: to water without injury. Ambergris is fuel, a fisherman trade, and an Echolocator ingredient. An Endolocator upgrades that tool to locate a nearby stronghold's End portal.
